t: A vision AI computer module and carrier board for smart cameras and robots.
steps: Buy the core module and carrier board from the BPI-Shop or the SINOVOIP AliExpress store.
Get a 12 V USB-C PD charger or a 12 V DC supply.
Download the Yocto or Armbian image from the Banana Pi docs.
Follow the Banana Pi getting started guide to flash the image.
Connect a monitor, keyboard, and Ethernet cable, then boot the board.
Log in and run a Linux update.
Try a Renesas DRP-AI sample model on a test image.
Add a MIPI camera next. Check the camera notes in the docs first.
meta: Open Board. From $211. A few stores.
